items.name: Dark Chocolate Muffins
items.description: Dive into decadent flavours with our Dark Chocolate Muffins Party Box, featuring rich and moist muffins, bursting with dark chocolate goodness. Perfectly portioned and ready to enjoy. An indulgent treat for chocolate lovers and a memorable addition to any gathering.

items.name: Swiss Rolls
items.description: Roll out the sweet memories with our Swiss Roll party box! Featuring a variety of light, fluffy sponge rolls with fillings that range for classic to rich chocolate, each slice offers a nostalgic treat with a modern twist.

items.name: Craquelin
items.description: Enjoy a French inspired twist with our Craquelin party box, featuring choux puffs pastry filled with luscious cream and topped with a light sweet crust. With their delightful crunch and creamy filling, these bites size treats bring a sophisticated touch to any gathering.

items.name: Chocolate Danish
items.description: Filled with gooey chocolate and baked to golden perfection, each Danish premises a melt-in-the-mouth experience that pairs perfectly with coffee, tea or a celebratory toast.

items.name: Chicken with Mushroom Pie
items.description: Save the warmth of hearty flavours with our Chicken Mushroom Pie Party Box. These savoury pies combined with tender chicken and earthy mushrooms. In a creamy filling encased in a buttery crust. Ideal for gathering and celebrations.

items.name: Fruit Tartlets
items.description: Brighten up your event with our Fruit Tartlets Party Box! These mini tarts are filled with a creamy based and topped with a colourful selection of fresh fruits, adding a burst of natural sweetness.

items.name: Quiche
items.description: A celebration of creamy textures and flavourful fillings, Our Quiche Party Box is perfect for brunches, office gatherings or evening soirees.  Each baked to perfections in a delicate pastry crust.

items.name: Cupcakes
items.description:
From birthday parties, to office events, these beautifully decorated cupcakes add charms, colours and tastes to any occasion!
This box set includes:
•	8 pcs x Lemon Vanilla Cupcakes
•	8 pcs x Dark Chocolate Cupcakes
•	8 pcs x Salted Caramel Cupcakes

items.name: Chinese New Year Cupcakes
items.description: Each cupcake is thoughtfully decorated with seasonal colours and designs, capturing the joy of the holiday flavours like vanilla and chocolate.

items.name: Nostalgic Butter Cream Cake
items.description: Each soft, fluffy cake is layered and finished with smooth, classic buttercream, bringing back familiar flavours that feel just like home.

items.name: Handcrafted National Day Cupcakes
items.description: 24pc Handcrafted NDP Cupcakes

items.name: Hari Raya Cupcakes
items.description: Celebrate the festive season with our Hari Raya Cupcakes Party Box! Each cupcake is beautifully decorated with traditional Hari Raya colors and designs, capturing the joy of the season with delightful flavors. Perfect for sharing with family and friends during this special time!

items.name: Christmas Cupcakes
items.description:
Celebrate the festive season with our Christmas Cupcakes Party Box! Each cupcake is thoughtfully decorated with seasonal designs,capturing the joy of the holiday flavours like vanilla and chocolate.
An ideal treat to share with family, friends and colleagues during this special time of yours.

items.name: Triple Decker Delight Sandwiches
items.description:
Delight Sandwiches is the ultimate choice for lunch or a cozy afternoon snack. Dive into a flavour-packed adventure that’s sure to satisfy your cravings! 
Try it today and experience the delight!

items.name: Gourmet Brioche Bliss Platter
items.description: Elevate your dining experience with our Gourmet Brioche Bliss Platter, a curated selection of soft, golden brioche buns filled with premium, mouthwatering ingredients. Each bite is a testament to quality and taste, crafted to impress and satisfy.

items.name: Blossoms & Delights (Mother’s Day Gift Box)
items.description: An elegant selection of handcrafted pastries and savoury bites thoughtfully curated for Mother's Day. Each eclair is delicately prepared with premium ingredients to create a memorable gift box perfect for celebrating the special woman in your life
